explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/596: for (G₁, G₂) = (C₄, C₆), 'Erdős and Hajnal [proved] the second [property] (in fact every C₄-free graph is a countable union of trees)'. The Lean variant HasCountableRamseyEscape (cycleGraph 4) (cycleGraph 6) states that every C₄-free graph H on a vertex type in Type has an edge partition d : ℕ → SimpleGraph into C₆-free classes (IsEdgeColouring: union is H, classes pairwise disjoint). This follows from the countable-union-of-trees result (forests contain no cycles, and a countable union can be made disjoint). Faithful.
